statement: Akamai said year-to-date multi-year Cloud Infrastructure Services contracts are collectively worth over $2.8 billion, including one new U.S. technology customer worth more than $600 million over four years.
why: Multi-year contract value many times current quarterly revenue is committed future demand for GPU cloud capacity that has to be built and equipped.

impact.mechanism: Signed multi-year cloud contracts force forward purchases of accelerators, datacenter space and power to deliver the committed capacity.

evidence.source: Akamai Technologies (official press release via GlobeNewswire)
evidence.excerpt: Year-to-date, we have signed numerous customers to multi-year CIS contracts, collectively worth over $2.8 billion.

evidence.source: Akamai Technologies (official press release via GlobeNewswire)
evidence.excerpt: This includes a contract with a U.S.-based technology company, which is also a new customer, worth more than $600 million over four years

confidence.basis: Secondary-tier newswire release; the $2.8 billion is a stated contract-value figure used as a backlog proxy rather than a reported RPO, and there is no independent corroboration.

dispersion: Contract value is a disclosed proxy: the release contained no explicit remaining-performance-obligation figure.
